title: attention-codegen-probe-induced-slowdown-action-plan
creator: Maya Hernandez
description: Summary: On 2026-02-26 17:12 UTC we detected a persistent p95 token-inference latency increase (approx +95%) for short-sequence chat workloads served by the hosted API. Impact: elevated latency across a subset of requests reduced overall throughput and caused partial SLA blips for a handful of customers. Root cause (high level): a regression in the attention codegen probe and kernel-selection heuristics caused the selector to prefer a generic matmul kernel path instead of the optimized fused-attention kernel for sequences <64 tokens when certain scheduler prefetch hints were present. The change surfaced after the scheduler prefetch change landed (runtime-1.22 release) and a micro-optimization in the codegen probe that altered measured micro-benchmark sampling order. Reproduction: locally reproduces with model xlarge-4b (fused-attn available) by running the short-seq synthetic workload with seq_len distribution peaked at 16 and enabling the new prefetch flag (--prefetch=enabled) on the scheduler; confirmed by tracing kernel selection in trace-id headers and GPU kernel names. Observed metrics: p95 CPU time per request up from 42ms -> 80ms; GPU kernel duration distribution shifted: fused_attention_opt calls dropped by ~68% for short sequences while generic_mm_v2 increased correspondingly. Temporary mitigations applied: 1) Canary rollback of the prefetch flag in the service fleet for affected regions on 2026-02-27, 2) Emergency hotfix that forces kernel affinity for short sequences for known model families, 3) Increased canary ramp & telemetry on kernel-selector decisions. Postmortem decision summary: do not revert runtime-1.22; instead stabilize the selector with a conservative fallback and create automated canary gating around codegen probe changes. Deliverables: stabilized kernel-selector heuristics, stronger unit/integration perf tests for attention-codegen, telemetry & lineage tagging for kernel decisions, automatic safety gates in rollout pipeline. This ticket tracks the cross-team follow-ups and action items.
